name: How much does it cost to install garage flooring, and what affects the price?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to install garage flooring, and what affects the price?

acceptedAnswer.text: Garage flooring installation costs vary based on square footage, concrete condition, and the coating system chosen. A standard two-car garage requires concrete grinding, crack patching, and multi-layer coating materials, with costs scaling up for larger footprints, severe pitting, or high-end clear coats. If a slab requires extensive leveling, moisture mitigation, or old paint removal before the new floor can be installed, prep work increases labor time. Because Abraham Becerra manages projects directly as an owner-operated contractor, estimates are tailored around exact slab conditions and scope rather than flat, one-size-fits-all package rates.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost depends on square footage, slab condition, crack repairs, and coating type. Concrete prep and moisture mitigation represent the largest variables.
